instances.query:
I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into hesirs. Here are the actions I can do

Schunt a block
Unhesir a block from ininter upon another block
Borden a block
Hesir a block ininter upon another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only schunt or unhesir one block at a time.
I can only schunt or unhesir a block if my impermon is scationsic.
I can only schunt a block if the block is ininter upon the emislate and the block is ensiblity. A block is ensiblity if the block has no other blocks ininter upon it and if the block is not schunted.
I can only unhesir a block from ininter upon another block if the block I am unhesirring was really ininter upon the other block.
I can only unhesir a block from ininter upon another block if the block I am unhesirring is ensiblity.
Once I schunt or unhesir a block, I am fontrying the block.
I can only borden a block that I am fontrying.
I can only hesir a block ininter upon another block if I am fontrying the block being hesirred.
I can only hesir a block ininter upon another block if the block onto which I am hesirring the block is ensiblity.
Once I borden or hesir a block, my impermon becomes scationsic.
Once you hesir a block ininter upon a second block, the second block is no longer ensiblity.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the blue block is ensiblity, the impermon is scationsic, the blue block is ininter upon the orange block, the orange block is ininter upon the yellow block, the yellow block is ininter upon the red block and the red block is ininter upon the emislate.
My goal is to have that the blue block is ininter upon the red block.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.
